name: industry-index
title: Industry index
description: Twelve to thirty industries as a compact index grouped by sector, each a link with a quiet customer count, and an optional live search.
docs: Pass sectors (a label and its industries, each with a name, an href, optionally a customer count and a featured flag). A featured industry leads its sector and is marked Popular in words; counts are tabular, quiet and read out as customers. Lists flow into one, two or three columns by the width of the block, and no industry is split across two. Set filterable to add a search field that narrows the index as you type and says how many are left; when nothing matches it says so and offers the contact link. Use locale for the numbers and labels to translate every word.
